summary: Support fixes wait for your approval, and updates come only as signed releases.

fixes.title: Support fixes wait for your approval
fixes.text: Fixes by Invardia support now wait on the Approvals page until an Admin or SuperAdmin of your environment approves each one. If a SuperAdmin chose to apply them automatically, that choice stays.

fixes.title: Signed updates only
fixes.text: PIM Manager and the hybrid worker now take updates only as signed releases from Invardia. The old unsigned source is removed; an installation still set to it refuses to update and says what to set.
